dedupe_keys.name: nber international finance and macroeconomics catalogue of data sources

description: This NBER page catalogues datasets on international finance and macroeconomics made available by researchers, together with researchers' descriptions of commercial data sources. Entries are arranged by topic: capital controls and macroprudential measures, exchange rates, financial crises, fiscal data, bank data, international prices, capital flows, external positions and interest parity, financial development and central banking, trade and firm data, with pointers to historical data overviews and to researchers' own data pages. It is maintained by the International Finance and Macroeconomics programme of the National Bureau of Economic Research, with contributions invited by email, and notes that NBER has arranged an Orbis subscription for its members. Coverage is global. The catalogue is free online, while each listed dataset keeps its own terms, and users are asked to cite the papers behind them. Caveats: it was last updated in July 2022, so links and versions may be dated, and it is a pointer list, not data. For simulation it helps locate datasets on banking crises, capital flows and exchange rates that calibrate financial contagion and stress scenarios affecting infrastructure finance. It is related to the Two Centuries of Systemic Bank Runs database record in this catalogue, a newer crisis dataset.
